messages.subject: Spatial add-on -> changing background?
parts:
Dear All,

I've just discovered Deducer (which is amazing) while looking for
spatial analysis techniques.

Is there any way to substitute the map background for a background of
one's choosing? In my particular case, an image of cells or tissue?

I realize this isn't what the spatial add-on was developed for and
perhaps there is other software which is more suitable, but the
spatial plotting is very nice. The possibility for combined spatial/
temporal analysis and plotting (stack of images) would be fantastic
(now I'm definitely asking too much).

Regardless, I will be using Deducer from now on. It is exactly what I
was looking for, thank you!

Kind regards,
Paul

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Spatial add-on -> changing background?
parts:
Well, that is pretty far outside the scope of the spatial plug in (it is a _spatial_ plug in after all). For an image analysis GUI focused on the medical field, you mAy want to take a look at ImageJ.

Best,
Ian

Sent from my iPhone
